awards.name: The Landslide
awards.description: For the track that won by the largest margin. Dominant performance, no contest.

measurement.qualifies: Winning track's margin over 2nd place is the largest seen this round (and margin >= 5 points)
measurement.calculation: margin = points_1st - points_2nd; qualifies if margin >= 5
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT winner WHERE (points_rank_1 - points_rank_2) >= 5 ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Miniature snow globe containing a mountain with rocks mid-avalanche, dramatic frozen motion, collectible figurine style, white background

awards.name: Photo Finish
awards.description: For the closest race of the week. When 1-2 points separate the top spots.

measurement.qualifies: Margin between 1st and 2nd place is <= 2 points
measurement.calculation: margin = points_1st - points_2nd; qualifies if margin <= 2
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT round WHERE (points_rank_1 - points_rank_2) <= 2

awards.trophy_prompt: Vintage polaroid camera with a photo emerging showing a tie, metallic gold finish, collectible object style, white background

awards.name: The Underdog
awards.description: Lowest average vote count that still cracked the top 3. Nobody saw it coming.

measurement.qualifies: Track finished in top 3 AND had the lowest average points-per-vote among top 3 finishers
measurement.calculation: avg_vote = sum(points) / count(votes); rank by total points; filter top 3; find min(avg_vote)
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track FROM top_3_tracks ORDER BY avg(points_per_vote) ASC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Small scrappy terrier dog figurine wearing a golden crown, standing proud, ceramic collectible style, white background

awards.name: Zero to Hero
awards.description: Track that received at least one 0-point vote but still finished strong overall.

measurement.qualifies: Track received at least one vote with points_assigned = 0 AND finished in top half of rankings
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track WHERE EXISTS(vote.points = 0) AND rank <= ceil(count(tracks)/2)

awards.trophy_prompt: Enamel pin of a zero digit wearing a tiny superhero cape, bold colors, pin badge style, white background

awards.name: The Shutout
awards.description: Track that received points from every single voter. Universal appeal.

measurement.qualifies: Every voter who voted in this round gave this track > 0 points
measurement.calculation: count(votes WHERE points > 0) == count(distinct voters in round)
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track WHERE min(points_received_per_voter) > 0 AND count(voters) = count(votes)

awards.trophy_prompt: Golden magnet attracting colorful music notes from all directions, 3D render style, white background

awards.name: The Kingmaker
awards.description: Voter whose points made the biggest difference in determining the winner.

measurement.qualifies: If you remove this voter's votes, the winner would change (or margin would flip)
measurement.calculation: For each voter: recalculate rankings without their votes; check if 1st place changes
measurement.sql_logic: FOR EACH voter: SELECT new_winner FROM votes WHERE voter_id != this_voter; compare to actual_winner

awards.trophy_prompt: Ornate chess king piece with a tiny crown being placed on top by a hand, bronze metallic finish, white background

awards.name: The Spread
awards.description: Voter who distributed points most evenly across all tracks. Democracy in action.

measurement.qualifies: Voter has the lowest standard deviation in points assigned across their votes
measurement.calculation: std_dev = stdev(points_assigned per voter); voter with min(std_dev)
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter_id ORDER BY STDDEV(points_assigned) ASC LIMIT 1
measurement.threshold: Must have voted on at least 5 tracks

awards.trophy_prompt: Butter knife spreading golden butter perfectly evenly on toast, satisfying smoothness, food illustration style, white background

awards.name: All In
awards.description: Voter who concentrated their points most heavily on a single track. Ride or die.

measurement.qualifies: Voter gave >= 50% of their total points to a single track
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE max(points_to_one_track) / sum(all_points) >= 0.5

awards.trophy_prompt: Stack of casino poker chips all pushed forward, dramatic betting gesture frozen in time, metallic and felt textures, white background

awards.name: The Snub
awards.description: Biggest gap between a track's final ranking and what one voter thought of it.

measurement.qualifies: Track finished 1st or 2nd overall BUT at least one voter gave it 0 or 1 points
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track, voter WHERE track.rank <= 2 AND vote.points <= 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Cold shoulder - a tiny figurine of a person looking away with arms crossed, frosty ice crystals on one shoulder, white background

awards.name: Cold Blooded
awards.description: Most zero-point votes cast in a single round by one voter.

measurement.qualifies: Voter gave 0 points to more tracks than any other voter this round (minimum 2 zeros)
measurement.calculation: count(votes WHERE points == 0) per voter; max count >= 2
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter_id ORDER BY count(votes WHERE points = 0) DESC LIMIT 1 HAVING count >= 2

awards.trophy_prompt: Realistic snake coiled around a frozen ice heart, scales glistening, dark elegant style, white background

awards.name: The Archaeologist
awards.description: Oldest track submitted this round. Digging in the crates.

measurement.qualifies: Track has the earliest release_year among all submissions this round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission ORDER BY release_year ASC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Tiny golden shovel stuck in dirt with a vinyl record partially unearthed, archaeological dig style, white background

awards.name: Fresh Pressed
awards.description: Newest track submitted. Keeping it current.

measurement.qualifies: Track has the latest release_year among all submissions this round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission ORDER BY release_year DESC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Steaming hot vinyl record fresh out of a record press, heat waves rising, industrial chic style, white background

awards.name: The Deep Cut
awards.description: Least-known track of the round, based on vote comments indicating unfamiliarity.

measurement.qualifies: Track received the most comments containing phrases like 'never heard', 'new to me', 'don't know this', 'first time', 'who is this'
measurement.calculation: count(vote_comments matching unfamiliarity keywords) per track; take max
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track ORDER BY count(comments LIKE '%never heard%' OR '%new to me%') DESC LIMIT 1
measurement.fallback: If no such comments exist, award is not given this round

awards.trophy_prompt: Iceberg with only tip visible above water, a music note hidden in the massive underwater portion, cross-section view, white background

awards.name: Genre Bender
awards.description: Submission furthest from the round's typical genre. The wildcard.

measurement.qualifies: Track's primary genre is shared by the fewest other tracks (ideally 0) this round
measurement.calculation: For each track, count how many other tracks share its primary genre; lowest count wins
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track ORDER BY count(other_tracks_same_genre) ASC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Pretzel twisted into the shape of a music note, golden baked finish, quirky food art style, white background

awards.name: The Oversharer
awards.description: Longest submission comment of the round. We appreciate the context.

measurement.qualifies: Submission has the longest comment (by character count) in this round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission ORDER BY LENGTH(comment) DESC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Overflowing diary with pages spilling out, tiny handwritten text visible, golden lock broken open, white background

awards.name: The Hype Man
awards.description: Most comments left on votes this round. They had thoughts.

measurement.qualifies: Voter left non-empty comments on more votes than any other voter
measurement.calculation: count(votes WHERE comment IS NOT NULL AND comment != '') per voter
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter_id ORDER BY count(non_empty_comments) DESC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Miniature megaphone covered in gold glitter with speech bubbles exploding out, energetic style, white background

awards.name: Anonymous No More
awards.description: Set 'Visible to Voters' to Yes when their pick was dead obvious.

measurement.qualifies: Submission has visible_to_voters = 'Yes' AND (is most associated with this submitter's known taste based on past submissions)
measurement.calculation: visible = 'Yes' AND track shares artist/genre with >50% of submitter's historical picks
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE visible = 'Yes' AND artist IN (SELECT artist FROM past_submissions WHERE submitter = this_submitter GROUP BY artist HAVING count > 1)
measurement.notes: Subjective fallback: can be awarded manually if group consensus is 'we all knew it was them'

awards.trophy_prompt: Masquerade mask falling off to reveal a winking face underneath, theatrical gold and black, white background

awards.name: The Recluse
awards.description: Submitted with no comment, received votes with no comments. A mystery.

measurement.qualifies: Submission has empty/null comment AND all votes for this track have empty/null comments
measurement.calculation: submission.comment IS NULL AND count(votes.comment WHERE track = this_track) == 0
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE comment IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM votes WHERE track = submission.track AND comment IS NOT NULL)

awards.trophy_prompt: Hermit crab in a beautiful shell with a tiny 'do not disturb' sign, peaceful solitude vibes, white background

awards.name: Controversial Pick
awards.description: Highest variance in points received. Loved by some, hated by others.

measurement.qualifies: Track has the highest standard deviation in points received across all voters
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track ORDER BY STDDEV(points_received) DESC LIMIT 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Marmite jar with a vinyl record label, 'love it or hate it' energy, iconic British product style, white background

awards.name: The Echo Chamber
awards.description: Two or more voters gave nearly identical point distributions.

measurement.qualifies: Two voters' point vectors have a Pearson correlation >= 0.9 OR exact match on all tracks
measurement.calculation: For each voter pair: compute correlation(voter_a_points, voter_b_points); if >= 0.9, qualifies
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter_a, voter_b WHERE CORR(a.points, b.points) >= 0.9
measurement.alternative: Exact match: all points identical for all tracks

awards.trophy_prompt: Two parrots facing each other on a perch, mirror image poses, speech bubbles with identical music notes, white background

awards.name: The Bridesmaid
awards.description: Always close, never wins. Finished 2nd or 3rd again.

measurement.qualifies: Player finishes 2nd or 3rd this round AND has finished 2nd or 3rd in at least 2 of their last 3 rounds
measurement.calculation: current_rank IN (2,3) AND count(last_3_rounds WHERE rank IN (2,3)) >= 2
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submitter WHERE rank IN (2,3) AND (SELECT count(*) FROM last_3_rounds WHERE rank IN (2,3)) >= 2

awards.trophy_prompt: Slightly wilted bouquet of flowers with a silver '2nd' ribbon, bittersweet beauty, romantic illustration style, white background

awards.name: The Comeback Kid
awards.description: Went from last place one week to top 3 the next.

measurement.qualifies: Player ranked last in round N-1 AND ranked 1st, 2nd, or 3rd in round N
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submitter WHERE prev_rank = (SELECT max(rank) FROM prev_round) AND curr_rank <= 3

awards.trophy_prompt: Phoenix bird rising from ashes shaped like broken vinyl records, flames in gold and orange, dramatic rebirth energy, white background

awards.name: Consistent Mediocrity
awards.description: Finished in the exact middle of the pack.

measurement.qualifies: Player's rank equals ceil(num_submissions / 2)
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submitter WHERE rank = CEIL(count(submissions) / 2.0)

awards.trophy_prompt: A perfectly level balance scale with a shrug emoji in the middle, beige and taupe colors, aggressively average energy, white background

awards.name: The Wooden Spoon
awards.description: Last place, but with dignity. Still got meaningful points.

measurement.qualifies: Ranked last AND received >= 50% of the average points for that round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track WHERE rank = max_rank AND points >= 0.5 * AVG(points)

awards.trophy_prompt: Elegant hand-carved wooden spoon with a tiny golden music note inlay, artisanal craftwork style, white background

awards.name: Unanimous Bottom
awards.description: Every voter ranked this track dead last in their personal voting.

measurement.qualifies: For each voter who voted on this track, points_assigned equals their min points given this round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT track WHERE ALL(vote.points = voter_min_points) AND track.rank = last

awards.trophy_prompt: Anchor sinking to ocean floor with bubbles rising, peaceful descent vibes, nautical illustration style, white background

awards.name: The Contrarian
awards.description: Voted opposite to the crowd.

measurement.qualifies: Voter gave their highest points to a bottom-3 track AND lowest points to a top-3 track
measurement.calculation: max(voter_points) → track.rank in bottom 25% AND min(voter_points) → track.rank in top 25%
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE track_with_max_vote.rank >= (count * 0.75) AND track_with_min_vote.rank <= (count * 0.25)

awards.trophy_prompt: Salmon swimming upstream against a current of other fish going downstream, determined expression, nature documentary style, white background

awards.name: The Prophet
awards.description: Correctly predicted the winner by giving them their max points.

measurement.qualifies: Voter's highest-pointed track finished 1st place
measurement.calculation: track WHERE voter gave max(points) matches track WHERE rank == 1
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE vote.track = winner AND vote.points = voter_max_points

awards.trophy_prompt: Crystal ball on an ornate stand with a tiny vinyl record visible inside glowing, mystical purple fog, fortune teller aesthetic, white background

awards.name: The Participation Trophy
awards.description: Voted on every track, even giving out zeros.

measurement.qualifies: Voter cast votes on all available tracks AND at least one vote was 0 points
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE count(votes) = count(tracks) - 1 AND EXISTS(vote.points = 0)

awards.trophy_prompt: Tiny plastic trophy with 'I tried' engraved on it, slightly crooked, elementary school awards day energy, white background

measurement.qualifies: sum(points_assigned) for this voter > all other voters

awards.name: The Scrooge

awards.description: Two or more voters had nearly identical point distributions.

measurement.qualifies: Two voters' point vectors have correlation >= 0.9 or exact match
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter_a, voter_b WHERE CORR(points_a, points_b) >= 0.9

awards.trophy_prompt: Two bees wearing headphones sharing a single music note between them, honeycomb pattern background element, cute insect illustration, white background

awards.name: The Sniper
awards.description: Only gave points to a small number of tracks. Concentrated fire.

measurement.qualifies: Voter gave >0 points to <= 3 tracks when >= 7 tracks were available
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE count(votes WHERE points > 0) <= 3 AND count(tracks) >= 7

awards.trophy_prompt: Single golden bullet standing upright with a music note engraved on it, precision and focus energy, military medal style, white background

awards.name: Time Traveler
awards.description: Submitted a track from a decade nobody else touched.

measurement.qualifies: Track's release decade has no other submissions this round
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE count(same_decade_submissions) = 1

awards.trophy_prompt: Pocket watch with vinyl record as the clock face, hands pointing to different decades, steampunk time travel aesthetic, white background

awards.name: Genre Orphan
awards.description: Submitted the only track of its primary genre this round.

measurement.qualifies: Track's first listed genre appears in no other submission
measurement.calculation: Split genres by comma, take first; count(other submissions with same primary genre) == 0
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE primary_genre NOT IN (SELECT primary_genre FROM other_submissions)

awards.trophy_prompt: Single different-colored puzzle piece that doesn't fit with the grey pieces around it, standing proud, misfit toy energy, white background

awards.name: The Repeat Offender
awards.description: Submitted an artist they've submitted before.

measurement.qualifies: Artist appears in a previous submission by the same submitter
measurement.calculation: count(past_submissions WHERE artist == current_artist AND submitter == current_submitter) >= 1
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE artist IN (SELECT artist FROM past_submissions WHERE submitter = current_submitter)

awards.trophy_prompt: Rubber stamp pressing down leaving multiple identical marks, ink splatter, bureaucratic repetition energy, white background

awards.name: The Novelist
awards.description: Longest submission comment of the round.

measurement.qualifies: len(comment) is maximum among all submissions this round AND >= 50 characters
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission ORDER BY LENGTH(comment) DESC LIMIT 1 HAVING LENGTH(comment) >= 50

awards.trophy_prompt: Tiny quill pen writing on an endless scroll that trails off the page, ink bottle nearby, epic storytelling energy, white background

awards.name: The One-Worder

measurement.qualifies: Submission has a non-empty comment with <= 3 words
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT submission WHERE comment IS NOT NULL AND word_count(comment) <= 3

awards.trophy_prompt: Single Scrabble tile with a music note on it, simple and minimal, less is more energy, white background

awards.name: The Critic
awards.description: Left the most vote comments this round.

measurement.qualifies: Voter has the highest count of non-empty comments on their votes (min 3)
measurement.calculation: rank(count(votes WHERE comment != '') GROUP BY voter) == 1 AND count >= 3
measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter ORDER BY count(non_empty_vote_comments) DESC LIMIT 1 HAVING count >= 3

awards.trophy_prompt: Fancy monocle with a tiny notepad and pencil attached by a chain, snooty reviewer energy, film critic aesthetic, white background

awards.name: The Ghost

measurement.sql_logic: SELECT voter WHERE count(votes) >= 5 AND count(vote_comments) = 0

awards.trophy_prompt: Friendly cartoon ghost wearing headphones, finger over lips in 'shh' gesture, translucent and floating, cute spooky style, white background

awards.name: The Procrastinator

measurement.qualifies: Submission has the latest Created timestamp in round

awards.name: Down to the Wire

awards.trophy_prompt: Tightrope walker balancing on a guitar string over a canyon, dramatic tension, circus daredevil energy, white background

season_awards.description: Biggest decline in ranking from season start to finish.

measurement.qualifies: Player with largest negative rank change comparing first half to second half

season_awards.trophy_prompt: Shooting star fading into darkness, bittersweet decline energy, once bright now dim, astronomical illustration, white background

season_awards.name: Genre Explorer
season_awards.description: Submitted the most diverse range of genres this season.

measurement.qualifies: Player with the highest count of unique genres in their submissions

season_awards.trophy_prompt: Compass with different genre symbols at each cardinal direction, musical exploration energy, adventure cartography style, white background

season_awards.name: Time Capsule
season_awards.description: Submitted tracks spanning the widest range of decades.

measurement.qualifies: Player with largest spread between oldest and newest track submitted

season_awards.trophy_prompt: Ornate hourglass with vinyl records floating inside instead of sand, time travel energy, antique meets music, white background

season_awards.name: The Voter
season_awards.description: Cast the most total points this season. Generous with appreciation.

measurement.qualifies: Voter with highest sum of points given across all rounds

season_awards.trophy_prompt: Ballot box overflowing with golden tickets and music notes, democracy meets appreciation, civic duty style, white background

season_awards.name: The Critic
season_awards.description: Left the most vote comments this season. Always had something to say.

measurement.qualifies: Voter with highest count of non-empty comments on votes
measurement.calculation: count(votes WHERE comment IS NOT NULL) per voter

season_awards.trophy_prompt: Vintage typewriter with music sheet paper scrolling out, prolific commentary energy, literary meets musical, white background

categories.performance: Awards based on how tracks placed in the rankings
categories.voting_behavior: Awards based on how a voter distributed their points
categories.submission_style: Awards based on the track/artist/comment choices
categories.social: Awards based on engagement, comments, and interaction
categories.timing: Awards based on when submissions and votes were cast
categories.relationship: Awards based on voting patterns between couples, siblings, and family
categories.theme: Awards based on round themes and theme creators
categories.season: Awards based on aggregate performance across an entire season

data_requirements.theme_creator_tracking: Need to add a 'Creator ID' field to rounds.csv to track who created each theme

usage_notes.per_round: Most awards are evaluated per round. Some (like Bridesmaid, Repeat Offender, Serial Procrastinator) require historical data.
usage_notes.thresholds: Several awards have minimum thresholds to avoid trivial qualification. Adjust based on your group size.
usage_notes.mutual_exclusivity: Some awards are mutually exclusive (e.g., Landslide vs Photo Finish). Only one should be given per round.
usage_notes.ties: When multiple people qualify, either award to all or pick randomly.
usage_notes.trophy_prompts: All prompts designed for AI image generation. Add 'icon style' or '3D render' or 'flat illustration' to taste. White background for easy compositing.
